agent.editable_files: exact target file per task only

analysis_rules.SFT_GRPO: not authorized by this protocol; all trials are Development feasibility only.
analysis_rules.automatic_public_feedback: After every successful structured replace_text or insert_text operation, the runner executes the immutable public test in the pinned no-network container and includes the result in that tool response. A later edit invalidates the previous pass and triggers a fresh test.
analysis_rules.binary_reward: 1 only when source was changed, fresh public test passed, candidate diff affects only the allowlisted target, and parent-side hidden grade passed; otherwise 0.
analysis_rules.pass_at_3: 1 if any of the three preregistered attempts for that task has reward 1, else 0.
analysis_rules.reward_variance: sample variance of the three binary rewards; GRPO readiness is not inferred from two Development groups.
analysis_rules.v2_failure_interpretation: Tool-call schema actions were selected, but calls were truncated at the fixed 512-token response ceiling; classify as format truncation, not semantic failure. V3 changes the ceiling and instruction in a new protocol.
analysis_rules.v3_observation: V3 produced one candidate patch on the tokenizer task, but it changed unrelated Qwen mapping values and did not complete the required test/repair cycle. Other trials either produced wrong patches or no patch.

instructions.transformers-49116-tokenizer-routing-v2: Add only the two missing model-type entries needed for qwen3_5_moe_text and qwen4_exp and include those names in the incorrect-Hub-tokenizer-class override set. Do not change any existing tokenizer mapping value or any other Qwen row. Use short structured edits, inspect the automated public-test result after each edit, then inspect the final diff.
instructions.transformers-49412-fusion-registration-i: Make identical repeated fusion registration a no-op while preserving errors for genuinely conflicting conversion mappings. Keep the edit only in the repeated-registration path inside _register_module_fusion; do not rewrite the function or alter unrelated mappings. Inspect the automated public-test result after each edit, then inspect the final diff.

limitations: Only two new Development tasks; this is not a held-out capability estimate.
Training-data contamination is unknown; do not claim these tasks are pretraining-unseen.
The public smoke tests are visible. Hidden expected values stay in the parent process.
No SFT, GRPO, or optimizer update is part of this experiment.
objective: Measure whether a real local coding model can produce, apply, publicly smoke-test, and independently pass patches on two previously unused Transformers Development tasks using hash-checked structured edit actions.
primary_metrics: reward variance per three-rollout task group
revision_reason: V3 demonstrated that larger outputs permit valid structured edits, but one task received no second test cycle before the turn budget ended and the other task edits violated preservation requirements. V4 automatically executes the immutable public test after every applied structured edit and returns the result in the same tool response, adds repair turns, and narrows the task-specific instruction.
